0022600182.text: The Denver Nuggets (3-3, 1-2 at home, on a three-game skid after a loss in their last outing) host the Toronto Raptors (4-3, on a one-game winning streak) in Denver's seventh game of the 2026-27 season, with the Nuggets 10th in the West and 2 games back in the Northwest. Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), and Jakob Poeltl (shoulder inflammation) is day-to-day and a gametime decision. The teams have not played each other in the 2026-27 season yet, and the Nuggets won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 121-115 victory in Denver on March 20, 2026.
